verdicts.reason: Both 320x50 versions have the same broken hierarchy. The legal disclaimer is set almost as large as the headline and takes up the whole right side, the subhead is dropped, the SOLSTICE wordmark sits under the headline, a tiny line of text runs over the top-left edge, and the Shop button is pushed into the left corner. In A the Blood Orange chip has shrunk to an unreadable sliver under the button, while B keeps all three flavour chips readable, so B is slightly less broken.
